newsitem.title: USA: NACCO to buy back up to 1.5 mln Class A shrs.
newsitem.headline: NACCO to buy back up to 1.5 mln Class A shrs.

text.p: NACCO Industries Inc said Friday it will start a Dutch auction tender offer to buy back up to 800,000 shares of its Class A common stock.
The purchase price will be no greater than $50.00 and no less than $43.50, it said.

The company said it also has authorized a buyback of up to 700,000 additional shares of Class A common stock on the open market. Those shares would be repurchased over the next two fiscal years after the tender offer is expired.
In total, the 1.5 million shares to be purchased as part of the tender offer and on the open market represents 21 percent of the company's outstanding Class A common stock.
As part of the Dutch auction, the company said it will accept the lowest purchase price that allows it to purchase all 800,000 shares. The tender offer will expire at midnight EST on December 16.
NACCO Industries said no director, executive officer or family member affiliated with them intends to sell any shares under the offer.
The number of outstanding Class A common stock shares was not immediately available.
